reviews.text: Used this in the morning to colour correct my dark circles, redness and discolouration and it lasted all day under my makeup. The coverage is the perfect consistency because it's not too thick that it looks cakey but it's not too sheer that you can see discolouration through it. You can build it up in layers which makes it easy to apply. It's also dewy and balmy which is nice because my skin is a bit dry.
reviews.zh: 朝早用嚟調色，遮黑眼圈、泛紅同膚色不均，一整日妝都keep得住。遮瑕度剛剛好，唔會厚到一撻撻，但又唔會薄到睇到下面嘅暗沉。可以一層層疊上去，所以好易用。質地仲有少少水潤同滋潤感，因為我皮膚有少乾，用落好舒服。

reviews.text: I've wanted to try colour correcting and have been looking for one with a few different colours that I can conveniently bring when I travel. I've previously tried #02 and decided to give #01 a try also to test out the various shades. I love this palette as it comes in so many colours, although I tend to use only some of them. The texture is slightly creamy so just a tiny dab is sufficient to give good coverage. This #01 is suitable to #17-21 foundation shades. I've previously been using "the saem" colour corrector for a few months already, so I find that not all the shades in this palette are useful for me. It is definitely a convenient option to have but I would suggest that it really depends on which shades you would tend to use more freq, you can consider getting this palette.
reviews.zh: 一直想試調色，想搵一盒有幾隻色、出差旅行又方便帶嘅。之前用過 #02，所以決定一試 #01，睇下唔同色號嘅效果。我鍾意呢盒入面有咁多顏色，雖然我通常只會用其中幾隻。質地有少許霜狀，輕輕一撳已經夠遮瑕。#01 適合 #17–21 粉底色號。我之前用過「the saem」調色霜幾個月，所以我覺得呢盒唔係每隻色都啱我用。帶出門的確方便，但建議要睇下你自己會常用邊幾隻色，再決定要唔要買。

reviews.text: I see youtube videos of people applying with their fingers, but as someone with extremely dry skin, I don't recommend that. Makes my makeup quite cakey and flakey, so I find mixing it with serum or something more liquidy and applying with a brush makes it better. Color correcting and concealing works pretty well though. My skin tone is usually 21. Don't recommend for beginners to makeup.
reviews.zh: 睇 YouTube 啲片見人都係用手指上，但我本身係極乾肌，唔建議咁做。會搞到妝容一撻撻仲甩皮，所以我會溝少少精華或者液體狀嘅嘢，再用掃上。調色同遮瑕效果其實幾好。我膚色通常用 21。唔建議化妝新手用。

reviews.text: Very versatile palette and really creamy in texture. I didn’t find the puff it came w to be very helpful. Also will need to mix the color correcting shades with the others to darken it so I think this palette might be better for those w a lighter complexion. Personally would not repurchase
reviews.zh: 呢盒好百搭，質地真係好 creamy。跟盒附送嘅粉撲我覺得唔算好用。仲有，調色嗰幾隻色要溝其他色先深得返，所以呢盒可能比較適合膚色較淺嘅人用。我自己就唔會再回購。

reviews.text: Perfect for beginners, the texture is soft and slightly thick and blends well to your natural skin! It has quite a bit of white in it, so even the darker concealer colors are actually pretty light. I'm a Makeup forever N00 and it's still light on me. The coverage is med to light (if you blend it out well) and long lasting if you set it with powder, over the course of many light layers!
reviews.zh: 適合新手，質地柔軟、略帶厚度，可以輕鬆推開融入你本身嘅膚色！入面偏白，所以即使是較深嘅遮瑕色號其實都好淺。我用 Makeup forever N00 色號，喺我臉上都仲係偏淺。遮瑕度中等至偏輕（如果你推開得夠好），配合碎粉定妝的話可以維持幾個鐘，要分幾層薄薄疊上！

reviews.text: My usual foundation shade is 21N-C, so I think these shades work nicely. The last contour shade is barely visible when blended, so I don’t think I would use it much. The overall concealer is creamy, but I find that it sadly settles into fine lines after a long time of wear.
reviews.zh: 我平時用嘅粉底色號係 21N-C，所以呢幾個色號我覺得幾啱用。最尾嗰個修容色推開之後幾乎睇唔到，所以我諗我唔會點用。整體遮瑕幾 creamy，但可惜戴耐咗會卡入細紋。

reviews.text:
Love that you get so many colors to perfect your base with (all with different textures but easy to blend and mix )
Something important is tha the overall tone of this palette is quite bright, so if you are a 21 or lighter go for it, but if you are a 22/23 or darker I would say get the Saem triple pot concealer instead.
reviews.zh:
鍾意呢盒有咁多色可以打造完美底妝（每隻質地都唔同但都好容易推開同混色）
有一點好重要，就係呢個 palette 嘅整體色調偏淺白，如果你係 21 或者更淺就可以買，但如果係 22/23 或者更深，我會建議你買 Saem 嘅 triple pot 遮瑕。

reviews.text: The palette is easy to use ( concealer, contouring, and highlighter). The light beige or ivory color can be used as a light foundation. I really like it because it is small, so it is easy to carry. I recommend to use a setting powder to keep the coverage ( especially for dark circle and dark spot).
reviews.zh: 呢個 palette 好易用（遮瑕、修容、打亮）。淺米色或者 ivory 嗰隻可以當作淺色粉底用。我好鍾意因為佢細細盒，帶出街好方便。建議配合碎粉定妝去保持遮瑕度（特別係眼圈同色斑）。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
